name: archive-stream-completion
goal: Archive patching returns only when every output byte is written and rejects destination errors.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: ASAR returns its stream before finish; patch must await destination completion and reject write errors.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: 2/2 failed: /tmp/harness-archive-stream-red.log. Detected premature digest and ignored write error.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Await finished(output) before hashing. Finish source fixture; preserve all archive-content assertions. Independent review approved.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: 3/3 passed: /tmp/harness-archive-stream-green.log. Reviewer rerun passed; held completion and write-error regressions unchanged.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
